theorems.name: Submission.tdo_slb_scaledLpNorm_le_of_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ) (z w : Amb n ℓ) (s t : ℝ), 0 < p → 0 < s → s ≤ t → closedBall z s ⊆ closedBall w t → V.scaledLpNorm H p z s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((s / t) ^ ((p - n) / p)) * V.scaledLpNorm H p w t
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
